I’m 76, worked as a registered nurse for 53 years, a wonderful husband, raised 4 well grounded boys and have Never been so excited and overflowing with joy and pride in my life. Tremendous peace that passes all understanding is with me daily.

Since the beginning of the C 19, hubby and I have set out each day to make each day ‘full of sunshine’ in as many small ways as we can think of. Ex: Early on I started a birthday/anniversary card sending list using a spread sheet. I have a bit over 70 names on that list now. (At my age, I keep a sticky on my computer with that months dates/names). Haven’t been late of one yet. Bottom line is we get some heartfelt feedback but actually we’re the ones who have benefited the most. Each card is chosen for the recipient and each one has a very personal note written. Another example is when we heard of a family’s move I made a double batch of cookies for the volunteers who helped with the move.

Lol, they had only 3 days to be out of their house the day their contract was signed. Happened the same day as the sellers contract was signed. What I’m trying to share is this: We can be filled to the brim with peace and joy when our eyes are on Him! I’ve learned (and still am) to love others. Every time a small negative thought appears that is negative toward someone, and that includes strangers, I try to replace it with a positive one. Um, instead of ‘seeing’ outward appearances, I work to ‘see’ inner appearances.

This path has led me to a better inner understanding of our Lord God Almighty. So, dear patriots, I know time has dragged on and it’s easy to become fatigued and a bit discouraged at times. My medical advice, heal yourself by doing something nice for others. This can be as simple as having what I call ‘smiling eyes’ as you pass through the day. It’s amazing the response I get with store clerks, especially when done with a few pleasant words. From people passing on the street, to interactions with family and friends.

Most important is to frequently remember those closest to us.......that is our spouse, children, etc. I myself was guilty of just assuming they knew how much I enjoy them in my life. But when I started using my ‘smiling eyes” with them too, wow I saw some amazing results. Just think, this is all in the Bible for a reason...because it works....it’s part of Gods plan for humanity. God bless all of you and remember, God wins.
